SELECT COUNT(*)

SELECT 
    s.MailStreet, 
    ss.sname

    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds

    ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL

    loan.loan_id, 
    district.A3 AS district, 
    district.A11 AS average_salary

    loan

    d.A2 AS district,

FROM 
    client c
INNER JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id

FROM card 
INNER JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id

    d.A3 AS state,

    card;

FROM trans AS T1
WHERE T1.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND T1.date LIKE '1998%'

SELECT 
    (sum_1997 - sum_1996) * 100.0 / sum_1996 AS growth_rate
FROM
    (SELECT SUM(loan.amount) AS sum_1996
     FROM loan
     JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
     JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
     WHERE client.gender = 'M'
       AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996'
    ) AS y1996,
    (SELECT SUM(loan.amount) AS sum_1997
     FROM loan
     JOIN disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
     JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
     WHERE client.gender = 'M'
       AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1997'
    ) AS y1997

INNER JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id

JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id

    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+')) AS percentage
FROM 
    molecule m

    m.label = '+'

    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'o' AND b.bond_type = '-'

FROM connected c

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

SELECT molecule_id, label

    a2.element

    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
INNER JOIN 
    atom AS a2 
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

SELECT COUNT(T3.bond_id)
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id

SELECT first_name, district, COUNT(*) AS name_count
FROM (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3 AS first_name, District AS district FROM schools
) AS combined_admins
WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY first_name, district
ORDER BY name_count DESC
LIMIT 2

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN atom.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.element) AS hydrogen_ratio,
    molecule.label
FROM 
    atom
INNER JOIN 
    molecule
ON 
    atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE 
    atom.molecule_id = 'TR006';

SELECT 
    atom.element, 
    COUNT(*) AS count
FROM 
    molecule
INNER JOIN 
    atom 
ON 
    molecule.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE 
    molecule.label = '+' 
    AND SUBSTR(atom.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4'
GROUP BY 
    atom.element;

FROM bond AS b
INNER JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR000_1_2' AND c.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

  CASE 
    WHEN bond_type = ' = ' THEN 'double bond'
    WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 'single bond'
    WHEN bond_type = '#' THEN 'triple bond'
    ELSE 'unknown bond'
  END AS bond_type
FROM 
  bond
WHERE 
  molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR050'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.element = 'cl'

JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id

FROM atom

              INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id = T3.atom_id

FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.frameVersion = 'future'

SELECT 
    cards.name, 
    set_translations.translation, 
    set_translations.language
FROM 
    cards
INNER JOIN 
    set_translations 
ON 
    cards.setCode = set_translations.setCode
WHERE

SELECT 
  c.name AS card_name,
  c.artist,
  CASE WHEN c.isPromo = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_promo_printing
FROM 
  cards c
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
      uuid, 
      COUNT(*) AS ruling_count 
    FROM 
      rulings 
    GROUP BY 
      uuid 
    ORDER BY 
      ruling_count DESC 
    LIMIT 1
  ) r ON c.uuid = r.uuid

FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'

  m.molecule_id, 
  CASE 
    WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'Carcinogenic'
    ELSE 'Non-Carcinogenic'
  END AS carcinogenicity
FROM 
  atom a
  INNER JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE 
  a.atom_id = 'TR001_10'

SELECT DISTINCT cards.id
FROM cards
INNER JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.types = 'Creature' AND legalities.status = 'Legal';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_molecules_with_double_bond, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_molecules_with_double_bond
FROM 
    bond AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    molecule AS T2 
ON 
    T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE 
    T1.bond_type = '=';

SELECT 
    c.name,
    (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Spanish' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id)) AS percentage_in_spanish
FROM 
    cards c
LEFT JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
GROUP BY 
    c.name
ORDER BY 
    percentage_in_spanish DESC

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM 
    cards c
JOIN 
    foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE 
    c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*'

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN s.type = 'expansion' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_expansion_sets
FROM 
    sets s
JOIN 
    set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE 
    st.language = 'Japanese'

SELECT 
    c.name AS card_name,
    r.text AS ruling_text,
    CASE

FROM 
    cards c
LEFT JOIN 
    rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE 
    c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele'
